#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a one-hour Team Meeting event for next Wednesday at 3 PM (local time)."""
import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone

OUT = "team_meeting.ics"


def next_weeks_wednesday(today: date) -> date:
    """Wednesday of the next ISO week (the week beginning next Monday)."""
    days_until_next_monday = (7 - today.weekday()) % 7  # Monday=0
    if days_until_next_monday == 0:
        days_until_next_monday = 7
    next_monday = today + timedelta(days=days_until_next_monday)
    return next_monday + timedelta(days=2)


def main():
    today = date.today()
    local_tz = datetime.now().astimezone().tzinfo
    event_date = next_weeks_wednesday(today)

    start_local = datetime(event_date.year, event_date.month, event_date.day, 15, 0, 0, tzinfo=local_tz)
    end_local = start_local + timedelta(hours=1)
    now_utc = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@team-meeting.local"

    summary = "Team Meeting"
    description = "Team meeting scheduled for next Wednesday at 3 PM (1 hour)."

    engine = "icalendar"
    try:
        from icalendar import Calendar, Event, Alarm
        cal = Calendar()
        cal.add("prodid", "-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN")
        cal.add("version", "2.0")
        event = Event()
        event.add("summary", summary)
        event.add("description", description)
        event.add("dtstart", start_local)
        event.add("dtend", end_local)
        event.add("dtstamp", now_utc)
        event.add("uid", uid)
        event.add("status", "CONFIRMED")
        event.add("sequence", 0)
        alarm = Alarm()
        alarm.add("action", "DISPLAY")
        alarm.add("description", "Team Meeting starts in 15 minutes")
        alarm.add("trigger", timedelta(minutes=-15))
        event.add_component(alarm)
        cal.add_component(event)
        ics = cal.to_ical()
    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - manual fallback
        engine = f"manual (icalendar unavailable: {exc.__class__.__name__})"
        start_utc = start_local.astimezone(timezone.utc)
        end_utc = end_local.astimezone(timezone.utc)

        def fmt(dt):
            return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

        ics = (
            "BEGIN:VCALENDAR\r\n"
            "VERSION:2.0\r\n"
            "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN\r\n"
            "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN\r\n"
            "BEGIN:VEVENT\r\n"
            f"UID:{uid}\r\n"
            f"DTSTAMP:{fmt(now_utc)}\r\n"
            f"DTSTART:{fmt(start_utc)}\r\n"
            f"DTEND:{fmt(end_utc)}\r\n"
            f"SUMMARY:{summary}\r\n"
            f"DESCRIPTION:{description}\r\n"
            "STATUS:CONFIRMED\r\n"
            "SEQUENCE:0\r\n"
            "BEGIN:VALARM\r\n"
            "ACTION:DISPLAY\r\n"
            "DESCRIPTION:Team Meeting starts in 15 minutes\r\n"
            "TRIGGER:-PT15M\r\n"
            "END:VALARM\r\n"
            "END:VEVENT\r\n"
            "END:VCALENDAR\r\n"
        ).encode("utf-8")

    with open(OUT, "wb") as f:
        f.write(ics)

    # Validation
    valid = False
    validation_detail = ""
    try:
        from icalendar import Calendar as ICal
        parsed = ICal.from_ical(open(OUT, "rb").read())
        events = [c for c in parsed.walk() if c.name == "VEVENT"]
        valid = len(events) == 1
        validation_detail = f"parsed {len(events)} VEVENT(s)"
    except Exception as exc:
        validation_detail = f"text check ({exc.__class__.__name__})"
        text = open(OUT, "rb").read().decode("utf-8")
        valid = all(k in text for k in (
            "BEGIN:VCALENDAR", "BEGIN:VEVENT", "UID:", "DTSTAMP:",
            "DTSTART:", "DTEND:", "SUMMARY:", "STATUS:", "END:VEVENT", "END:VCALENDAR"))

    print("== Team Meeting event created ==")
    print(f"Today (script runtime): {today.isoformat()} ({today.strftime('%A')})")
    print(f"Event date: {event_date.isoformat()} ({event_date.strftime('%A')})")
    print(f"Start: {start_local.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z (%z)')}")
    print(f"End:   {end_local.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z (%z)')}")
    print(f"Timezone used: {local_tz}")
    print(f"UTC range: {start_local.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat()} -> "
          f"{end_local.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat()}")
    print(f"Summary: {summary}")
    print(f"Status: CONFIRMED, 15-minute display reminder")
    print(f"UID: {uid}")
    print(f"Output file: {OUT}")
    print(f"Generation engine: {engine}")
    print(f"Validation: {'PASS - ' + validation_detail if valid else 'FAIL - ' + validation_detail}")
    if not valid:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Task-scoped helper: construct the requested team meeting calendar event.

Computes "next Wednesday" relative to the current date, constructs a
one-hour iCalendar event starting at 3:00 PM (local time, expressed in UTC),
writes it to a staging ICS file, and validates the required ICS fields.
"""
import os
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

WEDNESDAY = 2  # datetime.weekday(): Monday=0, Tuesday=1, Wednesday=2


def next_wednesday(from_date):
    """Return the next Wednesday strictly after from_date."""
    days_ahead = (WEDNESDAY - from_date.weekday()) % 7
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7  # today is Wednesday; use next week's Wednesday
    return from_date + timedelta(days=days_ahead)


def build_ics():
    now = datetime.now().astimezone()
    wed = next_wednesday(now.date())

    start_local = datetime(wed.year, wed.month, wed.day, 15, 0, 0,
                           tzinfo=now.tzinfo)
    end_local = start_local + timedelta(hours=1)

    def fmt_utc(dt):
        return dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

    uid = f"team-meeting-{wed.isoformat()}@task-scope"

    lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Team//Calendar Skill//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "METHOD:PUBLISH",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        f"UID:{uid}",
        f"DTSTAMP:{fmt_utc(now)}",
        f"DTSTART:{fmt_utc(start_local)}",
        f"DTEND:{fmt_utc(end_local)}",
        "SUMMARY:Team Meeting",
        "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting on next Wednesday at 3 PM for one hour",
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "SEQUENCE:0",
        "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
        "",
    ]
    return "\r\n".join(lines)


def validate(ics_text):
    required = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR", "VERSION:2.0", "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT", "UID:", "DTSTAMP:", "DTSTART:", "DTEND:",
        "SUMMARY:", "STATUS:CONFIRMED", "END:VEVENT", "END:VCALENDAR",
    ]
    missing = [r for r in required if r not in ics_text]
    if missing:
        raise SystemExit(f"Validation failed; missing fields: {missing}")
    try:
        from icalendar import Calendar
        cal = Calendar.from_ical(ics_text.encode("utf-8"))
        events = [c for c in cal.walk() if c.name == "VEVENT"]
        if len(events) != 1:
            raise SystemExit(f"Expected exactly 1 VEVENT, found {len(events)}")
    except ImportError:
        pass  # icalendar not installed; basic field checks above suffice
    return True


def main():
    ics_text = build_ics()
    validate(ics_text)
    out_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)),
                            "team_meeting_constructed.ics")
    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        f.write(ics_text)
    print(f"Constructed and validated: {out_path}")
    print("Meeting date (next Wednesday):",
          next_wednesday(datetime.now().date()).isoformat())
    print("--- ICS content ---")
    print(ics_text, end="")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Task-scoped helper: construct and validate the requested team meeting calendar event.

Computes next Wednesday (strictly after today) at 3:00 PM local time for one hour,
builds a minimal, standards-compliant iCalendar (RFC 5545) artifact for that single
event, validates its structure, and prints the exact content to stdout so the final
artifact can be written from verified values.
"""
import json
import sys
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone


def next_wednesday(today):
    # weekday(): Monday=0 ... Wednesday=2 ... Sunday=6
    days_ahead = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7  # today is Wednesday -> next Wednesday is a week away
    return today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)


def to_utc(dt_local):
    return dt_local.astimezone(timezone.utc)


def ics_format(dt_utc):
    return dt_utc.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")


def build_ics(start_local, end_local, uid, dtstamp):
    start_utc = to_utc(start_local)
    end_utc = to_utc(end_local)
    lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        f"UID:{uid}",
        f"DTSTAMP:{ics_format(dtstamp)}",
        f"DTSTART:{ics_format(start_utc)}",
        f"DTEND:{ics_format(end_utc)}",
        "SUMMARY:Team Meeting",
        "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting scheduled for next Wednesday at 3:00 PM, lasting one hour.",
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "SEQUENCE:0",
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
    ]
    return "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n"


def validate(ics_text):
    errors = []
    if ics_text.count("BEGIN:VCALENDAR") != 1 or ics_text.count("END:VCALENDAR") != 1:
        errors.append("calendar container missing or duplicated")
    if ics_text.count("BEGIN:VEVENT") != 1 or ics_text.count("END:VEVENT") != 1:
        errors.append("event component missing or duplicated")
    for field in ("VERSION:2.0", "PRODID:", "UID:", "DTSTAMP:", "DTSTART:", "DTEND:", "SUMMARY:Team Meeting"):
        if field not in ics_text:
            errors.append(f"missing required field {field!r}")
    return errors


def main():
    out_path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "team_meeting.ics"
    now = datetime.now().astimezone()
    wed = next_wednesday(now)
    start_local = wed.replace(hour=15, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
    end_local = start_local + timedelta(hours=1)
    uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@calendar-skill"
    dtstamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    ics_text = build_ics(start_local, end_local, uid, dtstamp)
    errors = validate(ics_text)

    report = {
        "output_path": out_path,
        "computed_on": now.isoformat(),
        "local_timezone": str(now.tzinfo),
        "next_wednesday_date": wed.date().isoformat(),
        "start_local": start_local.isoformat(),
        "end_local": end_local.isoformat(),
        "start_utc": to_utc(start_local).isoformat(),
        "end_utc": to_utc(end_local).isoformat(),
        "duration_hours": 1,
        "validation_errors": errors,
        "ics": ics_text,
    }
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
    if errors:
        print("VALIDATION FAILED", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    print("VALIDATION OK")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Task-scoped helper: build the ICS content for the team meeting on the next
Wednesday at 3 PM local time, lasting one hour. Emits the ICS to stdout and a
human-readable summary to stderr."""
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

WEDNESDAY = 2  # Python weekday(): Monday=0 ... Wednesday=2 ... Sunday=6
MEETING_HOUR = 15
DURATION_HOURS = 1


def next_wednesday_after(today):
    days_ahead = (WEDNESDAY - today.weekday()) % 7
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7  # "next Wednesday" from a Wednesday means 7 days out
    return today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)


def fmt_utc(dt):
    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")


def build_ics(start_local):
    end_local = start_local + timedelta(hours=DURATION_HOURS)
    uid = "team-meeting-{}-{}@calendar-skill.local".format(
        start_local.strftime("%Y%m%d"),
        datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ"),
    )
    lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "METHOD:PUBLISH",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        "UID:" + uid,
        "DTSTAMP:" + fmt_utc(datetime.now(timezone.utc)),
        "DTSTART:" + fmt_utc(start_local),
        "DTEND:" + fmt_utc(end_local),
        "SUMMARY:Team Meeting",
        "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting (created by calendar assistant)",
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
        "SEQUENCE:0",
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
        "",
    ]
    return "\n".join(lines)


def main():
    now = datetime.now().astimezone()
    target_date = next_wednesday_after(now)
    start_local = target_date.replace(
        hour=MEETING_HOUR, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0
    )
    end_local = start_local + timedelta(hours=DURATION_HOURS)

    ics = build_ics(start_local)

    # Local sanity checks before emitting.
    assert ics.startswith("BEGIN:VCALENDAR")
    assert ics.rstrip().endswith("END:VCALENDAR")
    assert ics.count("BEGIN:VEVENT") == 1 and ics.count("END:VEVENT") == 1
    assert start_local.weekday() == WEDNESDAY
    assert end_local - start_local == timedelta(hours=DURATION_HOURS)

    print(ics)

    # Summary to stderr (not part of the ICS artifact).
    print("EVENT_DATE=" + start_local.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), file=sys.stderr)
    print("EVENT_START=" + start_local.strftime("%H:%M"), file=sys.stderr)
    print("EVENT_END=" + end_local.strftime("%H:%M"), file=sys.stderr)
    print("TZ=" + str(now.tzinfo), file=sys.stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Task-scoped helper: construct and validate the requested team meeting event.

The trusted task: "Create a new calendar event for my team meeting next
Wednesday at 3 PM, lasting one hour."

This helper only computes the next-Wednesday date, builds a single VEVENT
(3:00 PM - 4:00 PM, one hour) inside a VCALENDAR, validates its structure,
and prints the result. It writes no files and touches no external state.
"""

from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone

EVENT_SUMMARY = "Team Meeting"
EVENT_HOUR_UTC = 15  # 3 PM, expressed in UTC


def next_wednesday(from_date: date) -> date:
    """Return the first Wednesday strictly after from_date."""
    days_ahead = (2 - from_date.weekday()) % 7  # Wednesday == 2
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7
    return from_date + timedelta(days=days_ahead)


def build_ics(event_date: date, dtstamp: str) -> str:
    lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        f"UID:team-meeting-{event_date.isoformat()}@calendar-skill",
        f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}",
        f"DTSTART:{event_date.strftime('%Y%m%d')}T150000Z",
        f"DTEND:{event_date.strftime('%Y%m%d')}T160000Z",
        f"SUMMARY:{EVENT_SUMMARY}",
        "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting scheduled for one hour (3 PM to 4 PM).",
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
        "SEQUENCE:0",
        "END:VEVENT",

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a one-hour Team Meeting event for next Wednesday at 3 PM (local time)."""
import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone

OUT = "team_meeting.ics"


def next_weeks_wednesday(today: date) -> date:
    """Wednesday of the next ISO week (the week beginning next Monday)."""
    days_until_next_monday = (7 - today.weekday()) % 7  # Monday=0
    if days_until_next_monday == 0:
        days_until_next_monday = 7
    next_monday = today + timedelta(days=days_until_next_monday)
    return next_monday + timedelta(days=2)


def main():
    today = date.today()
    local_tz = datetime.now().astimezone().tzinfo
    event_date = next_weeks_wednesday(today)

    start_local = datetime(event_date.year, event_date.month, event_date.day, 15, 0, 0, tzinfo=local_tz)
    end_local = start_local + timedelta(hours=1)
    now_utc = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@team-meeting.local"

    summary = "Team Meeting"
    description = "Team meeting scheduled for next Wednesday at 3 PM (1 hour)."

    engine = "icalendar"
    try:
        from icalendar import Calendar, Event, Alarm
        cal = Calendar()
        cal.add("prodid", "-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN")
        cal.add("version", "2.0")
        event = Event()
        event.add("summary", summary)
        event.add("description", description)
        event.add("dtstart", start_local)
        event.add("dtend", end_local)
        event.add("dtstamp", now_utc)
        event.add("uid", uid)
        event.add("status", "CONFIRMED")
        event.add("sequence", 0)
        alarm = Alarm()
        alarm.add("action", "DISPLAY")
        alarm.add("description", "Team Meeting starts in 15 minutes")
        alarm.add("trigger", timedelta(minutes=-15))
        event.add_component(alarm)
        cal.add_component(event)
        ics = cal.to_ical()
    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - manual fallback
        engine = f"manual (icalendar unavailable: {exc.__class__.__name__})"
        start_utc = start_local.astimezone(timezone.utc)
        end_utc = end_local.astimezone(timezone.utc)

        def fmt(dt):
            return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

        ics = (
            "BEGIN:VCALENDAR\r\n"
            "VERSION:2.0\r\n"
            "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN\r\n"
            "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN\r\n"
            "BEGIN:VEVENT\r\n"
            f"UID:{uid}\r\n"
            f"DTSTAMP:{fmt(now_utc)}\r\n"
            f"DTSTART:{fmt(start_utc)}\r\n"
            f"DTEND:{fmt(end_utc)}\r\n"
            f"SUMMARY:{summary}\r\n"
            f"DESCRIPTION:{description}\r\n"
            "STATUS:CONFIRMED\r\n"
            "SEQUENCE:0\r\n"
            "BEGIN:VALARM\r\n"
            "ACTION:DISPLAY\r\n"
            "DESCRIPTION:Team Meeting starts in 15 minutes\r\n"
            "TRIGGER:-PT15M\r\n"
            "END:VALARM\r\n"
            "END:VEVENT\r\n"
            "END:VCALENDAR\r\n"
        ).encode("utf-8")

    with open(OUT, "wb") as f:
        f.write(ics)

    # Validation
    valid = False
    validation_detail = ""
    try:
        from icalendar import Calendar as ICal
        parsed = ICal.from_ical(open(OUT, "rb").read())
        events = [c for c in parsed.walk() if c.name == "VEVENT"]
        valid = len(events) == 1
        validation_detail = f"parsed {len(events)} VEVENT(s)"
    except Exception as exc:
        validation_detail = f"text check ({exc.__class__.__name__})"
        text = open(OUT, "rb").read().decode("utf-8")
        valid = all(k in text for k in (
            "BEGIN:VCALENDAR", "BEGIN:VEVENT", "UID:", "DTSTAMP:",
            "DTSTART:", "DTEND:", "SUMMARY:", "STATUS:", "END:VEVENT", "END:VCALENDAR"))

    print("== Team Meeting event created ==")
    print(f"Today (script runtime): {today.isoformat()} ({today.strftime('%A')})")
    print(f"Event date: {event_date.isoformat()} ({event_date.strftime('%A')})")
    print(f"Start: {start_local.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z (%z)')}")
    print(f"End:   {end_local.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z (%z)')}")
    print(f"Timezone used: {local_tz}")
    print(f"UTC range: {start_local.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat()} -> "
          f"{end_local.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat()}")
    print(f"Summary: {summary}")
    print(f"Status: CONFIRMED, 15-minute display reminder")
    print(f"UID: {uid}")
    print(f"Output file: {OUT}")
    print(f"Generation engine: {engine}")
    print(f"Validation: {'PASS - ' + validation_detail if valid else 'FAIL - ' + validation_detail}")
    if not valid:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def validate(ics_text):
    errors = []
    if ics_text.count("BEGIN:VCALENDAR") != 1 or ics_text.count("END:VCALENDAR") != 1:
        errors.append("calendar container missing or duplicated")
    if ics_text.count("BEGIN:VEVENT") != 1 or ics_text.count("END:VEVENT") != 1:
        errors.append("event component missing or duplicated")
    for field in ("VERSION:2.0", "PRODID:", "UID:", "DTSTAMP:", "DTSTART:", "DTEND:", "SUMMARY:Team Meeting"):
        if field not in ics_text:
            errors.append(f"missing required field {field!r}")
    return errors


def main():
    out_path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "team_meeting.ics"
    now = datetime.now().astimezone()

    ics_text = build_ics(event_date, dtstamp)
    validate(ics_text)
    print(f"NEXT_WEDNESDAY={event_date.isoformat()}")
    print(f"DTSTAMP={dtstamp}")
    print("ICS_BEGIN")
    print(ics_text, end="")
    print("ICS_END")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Task-scoped helper: construct and validate the requested calendar event.

Trusted task: "Create a new calendar event for my team meeting next Wednesday
at 3 PM, lasting one hour."

Scope: computes the next-Wednesday date (strictly after today), builds exactly
one VEVENT (Team Meeting, 15:00-16:00 local time, one hour) inside a
VCALENDAR, validates the required ICS fields, and prints the computed date and
the ICS content. It writes no files and touches no external calendar state.
"""
import sys
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone

SUMMARY = "Team Meeting"
WEDNESDAY = 2  # datetime.weekday(): Monday=0 ... Wednesday=2 ... Sunday=6
MEETING_HOUR = 15
DURATION = timedelta(hours=1)


def next_wednesday(today: date) -> date:
    """First Wednesday strictly after today."""
    days_ahead = (WEDNESDAY - today.weekday()) % 7
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7  # today is Wednesday -> next week's Wednesday
    return today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)


def fmt_utc(dt: datetime) -> str:
    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")


def build_ics(event_date: date, local_tz, dtstamp: datetime) -> str:
    start_local = datetime(event_date.year, event_date.month, event_date.day,
                           MEETING_HOUR, 0, 0, tzinfo=local_tz)
    end_local = start_local + DURATION
    uid = f"team-meeting-{event_date.isoformat()}@calendar-skill.local"
    return "\r\n".join([
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "METHOD:PUBLISH",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        f"UID:{uid}",
        f"DTSTAMP:{fmt_utc(dtstamp)}",
        f"DTSTART:{fmt_utc(start_local)}",
        f"DTEND:{fmt_utc(end_local)}",
        f"SUMMARY:{SUMMARY}",
        "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting on next Wednesday at 3 PM for one hour",
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
        "SEQUENCE:0",
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
        "",
    ])


def validate(ics_text: str, event_date: date) -> None:
    checks = {
        "calendar wrapper": ics_text.startswith("BEGIN:VCALENDAR"),
        "calendar close": ics_text.rstrip().endswith("END:VCALENDAR"),
        "single event": ics_text.count("BEGIN:VEVENT") == 1
        and ics_text.count("END:VEVENT") == 1,
        "uid": "UID:team-meeting-" in ics_text,
        "dtstamp": "DTSTAMP:" in ics_text,
        "dtstart": "DTSTART:" in ics_text,
        "dtend": "DTEND:" in ics_text,
        "summary": f"SUMMARY:{SUMMARY}" in ics_text,
        "3 PM start": f"{event_date.strftime('%Y%m%d')}T150000Z" in ics_text,
        "one-hour end": f"{event_date.strftime('%Y%m%d')}T160000Z" in ics_text,
    }
    failed = [name for name, ok in checks.items() if not ok]
    if failed:
        raise AssertionError("Validation failed: " + ", ".join(failed))
    try:
        from icalendar import Calendar
        cal = Calendar.from_ical(ics_text.encode("utf-8"))
        events = [c for c in cal.walk() if c.name == "VEVENT"]
        if len(events) != 1:
            raise AssertionError(f"Expected 1 VEVENT, found {len(events)}")
        if str(events[0].get("summary")) != SUMMARY:
            raise AssertionError("Unexpected SUMMARY")
    except ImportError:
        pass  # icalendar unavailable; field-level checks above suffice


def main() -> None:
    now = datetime.now().astimezone()
    event_date = next_wednesday(now.date())
    dtstamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    ics_text = build_ics(event_date, now.tzinfo, dtstamp)
    validate(ics_text, event_date)

    print(f"NEXT_WEDNESDAY={event_date.isoformat()}")
    print(f"DTSTAMP={fmt_utc(dtstamp)}")
    print(f"LOCAL_TZ={now.tzinfo}")
    print("ICS_BEGIN")
    print(ics_text, end="")
    print("ICS_END")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
